xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Deputy Commissioner of CGST & CX Division-VI, Thane CGST Commissionerate.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Order dated 20th January 2025, disallowing the Input Tax Credit (“ITC”) and demanding recovery of ITC amounting to Rs. 1,16,25,422 (Rupees One Crore Sixteen Lakh Twenty-Five Thousand Four Hundred Twenty-Two) along with applicable interest thereon and also levying a penalty of Rs. 1,16,25,422 (Rupees One Crore Sixteen Lakh Twenty-Five Thousand Four Hundred Twenty-Two) under the applicable provisions of the CGST/MGST / IGST Act.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The matter relates to Show Cause Notice (SCN) pertaining to FY 2017-18 alleging wrong availment of ITC. The Company had submitted a detailed point-wise response to the allegations raised in SCN. However, the adjudicating authority did not consider the reply properly.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: Tax: Rs. 1,16,25,422 along with applicable interest thereon. Penalty: Rs. 1,16,25,422 The Company believes that the above demand is not maintainable and accordingly.The Company has filed an appeal against the order on 18th April, 2025 and is confident that the demand of tax, interest and penalty will be dropped by Appellate Authority.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Joint Commissioner, CGST, Noida Uttar Pradesh
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Order dated 28th January 2025, disallowing the Transitional Input Tax Credit (“ITC”) and demanding recovery of the ITC amounting to Rs. 1,92,12,510 (Rupees One Crore Ninety-Two Lakh Twelve Thousand Five Hundred Ten Only) along with applicable interest thereon and also levying a penalty of Rs. 1,92,12,510 (Rupees One Crore NinetyTwo Lakh Twelve Thousand Five Hundred Ten Only) under the applicable provisions of the CGST / UPGST Act.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The matter relates to Show Cause Notice (SCN) pertaining to FY 2017-18 alleging wrong availment of Transitional ITC. The Company had submitted a detailed response to the allegations raised in SCN. However, the adjudicating authority did not consider the reply properly.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: Tax: Rs. 1,92,12,510 along with applicable interest thereon, Penalty: Rs. 1,92,12,510. The Company believes that the above demand is not maintainable and accordingly, The Company will file an appeal against the order and is confident that the demand of tax, interest and penalty will be dropped by Appellate Authority.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Additional Commissioner Of Customs, Noida Customs Commissionerate
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
The Company vide its Letter dated 9th April,2024 has informed that the Company has received an Order from Additional Commissioner, Noida Customs Commissionerate, Uttar Pradesh, dated 22nd March, 2024 (received on 9th April, 2024) demanding an amount of Rs. 33.43 Crore as duty short paid along with applicable interest and imposing penalty of Rs. 82 Crore under the Customs Act, 1962. In the same order, redemption fine of Rs.191.76 Crore was also imposed on the goods already cleared during the period from 1st July 2017 to 1st February 2021.
Thereafter, an appeal against the said order was filed on7th June 2024, before the Commissioner of Customs (Appeals), GST Bhawan, Sector-48, Noida.
